panels.title: Kill Switch
panels.description: kill_switch_state{state="RUNNING"} — 1 while RUNNING; any other engaged state pulls this to absent/0. Health-strip mirror of the Trading row's Kill Switch stat (id 8).

panels.title: Effective Mode
panels.description: mode_info{effective} — the live paper/live verdict at a glance; EffectiveModeLive is an info-level alert, not an error. See the Ops row's Mode stat (id 47) for requested→effective.

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: equity_usdt — cash + Σ position×mark, the one book. Health-strip mirror of the Trading row's Equity stat (id 1).

panels.title: Day PnL
panels.description: day_pnl_usdt — equity minus start-of-day-UTC equity. Health-strip mirror of the Trading row's Day PnL stat (id 4).

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: drawdown_ratio — (peak − equity) / peak, 0..1. RISK_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT halts at 0.20; thresholds mark half (0.10) and three-quarters (0.15) of the halt line for early warning.

panels.title: Decision Age
panels.description: max(created_at) from agent_decisions (Postgres RO) — same journal-freshness query as the Model & Learning row's Age of Last Decision (id 34; the v2 Overview row used this per-lane, v3 carries one lineage). Rendered as relative time; created_at is epoch-ms.

panels.title: Reconcile Status
panels.description: sum by (venue, result) (increase(reconciliation_runs_total[5m])) — per-venue pass outcomes in the last 5m (clean/mismatch/halt/error), so one venue's HALT is never masked by the other's clean passes (v3 spec §8). Absent entirely outside paper/testnet mode — trading-runtime.module.ts only schedules reconcile() there.

panels.title: Budget Remaining
panels.description: agentic_budget_remaining_usd — ONE unified book-wide daily LLM budget. Health-strip mirror of the Model & Learning row's Budget Remaining Today stat (id 23).

panels.title: App RSS
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes (prom-client default) — same signal as the Ops row's Process RSS (id 49), tighter early-warning thresholds (0.9/1.2 GiB) for the top-of-dashboard strip. Drives AppMemoryHigh (>1.2 GiB for 10m) against the compose mem_limit (1536m).

panels.title: Venue Free Cash
panels.description: venue_free_cash_usdt{venue} — free quote/margin balance per venue wallet. Health-strip mirror of the Trading row's Venue Free Cash stat (id 15).

panels.title: Kill Switch
panels.description: kill_switch_state{state="RUNNING"} — 1 while RUNNING; any other engaged state pulls this to absent/0. One switch, book-wide (v3: both venues flatten/cancel through the same routing EXCHANGE_PORT).

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: drawdown_ratio — (peak − equity) / peak, 0..1. RISK_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT is the kill threshold (0.20); thresholds mark half (0.10) and three-quarters (0.15) of the halt line for early warning.

panels.title: Open Orders (by venue)
panels.description: open_orders{venue} — v3 §8: venue-scoped fact, one series per venue (binance/binanceusdm) rather than the v2 per-process total.

panels.title: In-Flight Intents (by venue)
panels.description: in_flight_intents{venue} — v3 §8: reserved-intent count per venue.

panels.title: Venue Free Cash
panels.description: venue_free_cash_usdt{venue} — NEW (v3 §6.4): free quote/margin balance in each venue wallet, the capital-split's observable.

panels.title: Venue Capital Headroom
panels.description: venue_capital_headroom_usdt{venue} — NEW (v3 §6.1): venueCap(v) − open notional − reserved notional. Zero/negative means the next entry on that venue is BELOW_MINIMUM (headroom-exhausted, not a dust order).

panels.title: Realized PnL (by venue/strategy/symbol)
panels.description: realized_pnl_usdt{venue,strategy,symbol} — where PnL is actually coming from, now venue-labeled (v3 §8).

panels.title: Position Notional (by venue/strategy/symbol)
panels.description: position_notional_usdt{venue,strategy,symbol} — abs(position) × avgEntry, display-grade (v3 §8: +venue label).

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: equity_usdt — cash + Σ position×mark, the one book (v3: no per-venue split — a venue's capital share is a sizing clamp, not a second book).

panels.title: Cash
panels.description: cash_usdt — free quote (USDT) balance, book-wide.

panels.title: Peak Equity
panels.description: peak_equity_usdt — high-water mark, persisted across restarts.

panels.title: Day PnL
panels.description: day_pnl_usdt — equity minus start-of-day-UTC equity.

panels.title: Unrealized PnL
panels.description: unrealized_pnl_usdt — Σ signedQty×(mark − avgEntry) on open positions, embedded in equity above.

panels.title: Starting Cash
panels.description: starting_cash_usdt — the seed baseline (PortfolioConfig.startingCash), the return-since-inception denominator.

panels.title: Promotion Net PnL
panels.description: agentic_promotion_net_pnl_usd — realized PnL minus fees minus LLM spend over the earned-live promotion evidence window (PromotionReadinessService, sampled 5m). ONE lineage, ONE book (v3: no per-lane split).

panels.title: Promotion Round Trips
panels.description: agentic_promotion_round_trips — closed demo round trips toward the >=30 promotion threshold.

panels.title: Promotion Window Days
panels.description: agentic_promotion_window_days — span between the first and last closed demo round trip; must reach >=14.

panels.title: Promotion Ready
panels.description: agentic_promotion_ready — the earned-live verdict (>=30 closed demo round trips AND positive net-of-cost PnL over >=14 days). A permitted verdict still faces the unchanged four live gates and bootId-bound arming ceremony.

panels.title: Reconciliation Runs (by venue/result)
panels.description: increase(reconciliation_runs_total{venue,result}[5m]) — one pass per venue per 30s tick (v3 §1.5), one series per venue×result. result="halt" pages ReconciliationHalt; result="error" pages ReconcilePassErrors.

panels.title: Funding Payments Ingested (by venue/symbol)
panels.description: increase(funding_payments_ingested_total{venue,symbol}[1h]) — perp funding-settlement rows ingested (FundingIngestService, hourly poll).

panels.title: Active Playbook Version
panels.description: agentic_playbook_info{version} — one lineage, one series now (v3 §9: the two per-lane version sequences collapse into one).

panels.title: Agent Client
panels.description: agent_client_info{kind} — 'stub' (inert, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / test/ci) vs 'anthropic' (live, actually deciding).

panels.title: Budget Remaining Today
panels.description: agentic_budget_remaining_usd — ONE unified book-wide daily LLM budget (v3 §3.3: the two lane-split budgets merge into AGENTIC_DAILY_COST_STOP_USD=3).

panels.title: Active Menu Size
panels.description: count(agentic_active_menu == 1) — combined 40-symbol basket (24 spot + 16 perp), menu size 8 (v3 §5.2).

panels.title: Consult Gate Outcomes
panels.description: increase(agentic_consult_gate_total{outcome}[1h]) — consulted / skipped_scheduled / forced_fill / forced_move / forced_fallback / forced_rearm (all outcomes exported — XA1).

panels.title: Reflection Outcomes
panels.description: increase(agentic_reflection_outcomes_total{outcome}[6h]) — every silent exit in the reflection loop is now a named outcome (W2).

panels.title: Menu Churn
panels.description: increase(agentic_menu_churn_total{direction}[1h]) — combined-basket scanner menu entering/leaving symbols per recompute.

panels.title: Playbook Validator Rejections
panels.description: increase(playbook_validator_rejections_total{banned_token,token}[6h]) — a sustained pattern means the reflection loop can never iterate (AgenticReflectionRejects alert).

panels.title: Venue TP Events (by venue/event)
panels.description: increase(agentic_venue_tp_total{venue,event}[1h]) — v3 §8: +venue. Venue-resting take-profit lifecycle for plan-mode longs.

panels.title: Venue Stop Events (by venue/event)
panels.description: increase(agentic_venue_stop_total{venue,event}[1h]) — v3 §8: +venue. force_fired means a venue stop evidently failed to fill on its own — worth an operator look.

panels.title: Capability Violations (by kind)
panels.description: increase(agentic_capability_violations_total{kind}[6h]) — NEW (v3 §4.3): a decision degraded to hold for violating its symbol's capabilities (e.g. open_short on a spot symbol).

panels.title: Playbook Version Attribution — Net PnL
panels.description: agentic_version_net_pnl_usd{version} — champion/candidate A/B attribution, unchanged by v3 (still feeds attributed auto-promotion).

panels.title: Playbook Version Attribution — Round Trips
panels.description: agentic_version_round_trips{version} — closed demo round trips attributed to the playbook version active at entry.

panels.title: Age of Last Decision
panels.description: max(created_at) from agent_decisions (Postgres RO) — one journal, one lineage now (v3: no per-lane split). Rendered as relative time; created_at is epoch-ms.

panels.title: Consults Today
panels.description: sum(increase(agentic_consult_gate_total{outcome=~"consulted|forced_fill|forced_move|forced_fallback|forced_rearm"}[24h])) — actual LLM consults today (not all gate evaluations).

panels.title: LLM Tokens (by kind/model)
panels.description: increase(agent_tokens_total{kind,model}[1h]) — input/output/cache_read/cache_creation, split by model (decide vs reflection tiers).

panels.title: Decide Outcomes (by outcome/model)
panels.description: increase(agent_decide_total{outcome,model}[1h]) — proposed/hold/noop/error_retryable/error_fatal/timeout/budget_blocked.

panels.title: Decide Latency (p50)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.5, agent_decide_latency_seconds) — Sonnet decide-call latency.

panels.title: Promotion LLM Cost
panels.description: agentic_promotion_llm_cost_usd — DB-backed, per-model, cache-aware LLM spend over the promotion evidence window (context for Promotion Net PnL in the Trading row).

panels.title: Budget Remaining vs $3/day Breaker
panels.description: agentic_budget_remaining_usd against AGENTIC_DAILY_COST_STOP_USD=3 (v3 §5.2: menu-8 × 16 wakes ≈ $2.40/day planning target).

panels.title: Event Loop Delay (p99)
panels.description: event_loop_delay_p99_seconds — budget 50ms (EventLoopBudgetBreach alert); a sustained breach starves the strategy → risk → execution hot path.

panels.title: Event Loop Utilization
panels.description: event_loop_utilization — EventLoopUtilizationHigh alerts above 0.9 sustained 5m.

panels.title: Market Channel Staleness (by venue/symbol/channel)
panels.description: market_channel_staleness_seconds{venue,symbol,channel} — v3 §8: +venue. MarketChannelStale pages at >600s on ticker/candle channels.

panels.title: Market Stream Forced Reconnects (by venue)
panels.description: increase(market_stream_forced_reconnects_total{venue}[1h]) — v3 §8: +venue, pending workstream #5's per-venue MarketStreamsModule facade (today's aggregate labels the sole configured venue, or 'aggregate' once a second venue is live — see metrics.service.ts's own comment). MarketStreamReconnectStorm pages at >=5/hour.

panels.title: Derivatives Feed Staleness
panels.description: derivatives_feed_staleness_seconds (-1 = never polled) — funding/OI/mark-basis context feed, book-wide poller.

panels.title: Sentiment Feed Staleness
panels.description: sentiment_feed_staleness_seconds (-1 = never polled) — CryptoPanic headline feed, book-wide poller.

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: mode_info{requested,effective} — paper-honesty visibility; EffectiveModeLive is an info-level alert, not an error.

panels.title: Boot
panels.description: boot_info{boot_id} — the bootId-bound arming ceremony's own identifier.

panels.title: Process RSS
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes (prom-client default) — drives AppMemoryHigh (>1.2 GiB for 10m) against the compose mem_limit (1536m). v3 §8 footprint acceptance: app ≤ ~1.2 GiB.
